title: Anthropic lifts Fable 5 ban under new US government rules #anthropic #aigovernance #fable5
description: Anthropic lifted the ban on Fable 5, officially relaunching the model with restrictions. The most powerful public version of Claude returns, although coding and debugging tasks will still partly rely on the older Opus 4.8 model, with some tasks flagged for manual routing without full transparency. This relaunch comes with three major conditions: proactively managing security risks for Fable 5, Mythos 5, and future models; collaborating with the government on standards and release protocols for new AI systems; and reporting any malicious use of these models to authorities. This development marks a significant shift toward government involvement in AI deployment and oversight, potentially setting a precedent for other leading labs like OpenAI and Google. The cooperation signals an emerging regulatory framework around frontier AI technologies, balancing innovation with security concerns. It highlights the increasingly complex relationship between AI companies and governments as control over cutting-edge AI systems grows tighter. #Anthropic #Fable5 #ClaudeAI #AIregulation #Opus48 #Mythos5 #AIsafety #AIlaws #AIoversight #AIsecurity #FrontierAI #OpenAI #GoogleAI #ArtificialIntelligence
